diagnosis: Webhook events are retained for manual replay for a seven‑day window after delivery. After two weeks the events are no longer available for replay.
reply: Unfortunately, webhook events can only be replayed within seven days of the event occurring, so the events missed during your two‑week outage are no longer available for replay. If you need a historical data extract, you can try using our data export feature or contact us for further assistance. Let us know what else we can help with.
